citations.quote: Mr. client, I know it may look like the market has stopped. But reality is, the market shifted. Now, people are buying very smart. Demand didn't disappear. Buyers became more selective.

observation.text: The speaker uses a reassuring and explanatory tone to inform the client about the market dynamics.

citations.quote: But reality is, the market shifted. Now, people are buying very smart. Demand didn't disappear. Buyers became more selective.

summary.text: The market hasn't stopped, it has shifted; people are buying more smartly and selectively.
